data.gender_notes: Himmat is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Himmat is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘himmati’ which means courage and bravery. It is a name given to a boy who is believed to possess a strong and fearless spirit. In Hindu mythology, Himmat is associated with the god Indra, the deity of war and courage. The name Himmat carries the meaning “Courage, Brave heart” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Himmat usually hope their child will grow to embody courage, brave heart and live with faith, good character and purpose.
